title: Give notice of change of details for person with significant control (PSC04)
text:
This form can be used to notify Companies House of change of details of individual person with significant control.

 It takes longer to process paper forms sent to us by post.

 Use the online service to update your PSC information as quickly as possible.

 Forms need to be printed at full size on white A4 size paper.

 Nationalities and countries

 Use our list of nationalities and countries to complete your form. We’ll only accept entries from this standard list.
